title: Enrich public business websites
description: Enter business website URLs. SiteSignal reads a bounded number of public HTML pages and returns observed contacts with source evidence. It does not search for people, guess email addresses or verify deliverability.

websites.title: Business website URLs
websites.description: One public business website URL per line, up to 1,000 inputs. maxSites limits processed domains.

maxSites.title: Maximum websites
maxSites.description: Maximum number of unique websites to process. Your run spending limit may reduce this further.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Maximum pages per website
maxPagesPerSite.description: Homepage plus same-site contact/support pages, up to this limit. More pages can find more public contacts but take longer.

includeTechnology.title: Detect website technologies
includeTechnology.description: Look for recognizable CMS, ecommerce, analytics and payment signatures in fetched HTML. Detection is observational and may be incomplete.

respectRobots.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobots.description: Enabled by default. Pages excluded by robots.txt are skipped and reported in diagnostics.

concurrency.title: Concurrent websites
concurrency.description: Maximum websites in progress at once. Each site's pages are fetched sequentially.

timeoutSeconds.title: Request timeout in seconds
timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for each HTTP request. Unreachable sites produce diagnostics, not billable rows.

minDelaySeconds.title: Minimum delay between requests to one website
minDelaySeconds.description: Minimum per-site pause in seconds. Robots crawl-delay may require a longer pause.
